negative_knowledge: GitHub REST API returns 403 from this environment. Use firecrawl scrape of the profile HTML instead.
NEVER round-trip source files through PowerShell Get-Content/Set-Content. It adds a BOM and mangles em-dashes. Use the edit tool.

PowerShell's console renders UTF-8 em-dashes and middots as U+FFFD on output. A '?' in terminal output is NOT evidence of file corruption. Verify by decoding bytes with an explicit UTF8Encoding before concluding anything is broken.
firecrawl_search/includeDomains=open.spotify.com returns mashups and wrong tracks; a literal user typo ('askhe') was the real title ('Ashke'). Always confirm track identity via oEmbed.

vite preview serves dist, not source. A rebuild produces a NEW hashed filename; the browser can keep running the OLD bundle. Always hard-reload (location.reload(true)) after a rebuild before judging results.

SpaceUI registry: components are named 'components-spaceui-<name>' and blocks 'block-<name>-1'. Bare names return HTML and break shadcn add. A registry block that imports next/image cannot compile in this Vite SPA.
SpaceUI theme tokens are --color-info / --color-success / --color-warning. There is no --color-danger.
Math.min(clientX, innerWidth - clientX) is distance to the nearest EDGE, so a SMALL value means 'in the gutter'. Inverting this silently disables the cursor effect while still looking plausible.
The Paper Shader runtime sets premultipliedAlpha and blends (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA); unpremultiplied vec4(u_tint, a) makes u_opacity a no-op. Retired in favour of the DOM ProximityGrid.
useState(PRESETS[1].x) where PRESETS is 'as const' pins state to that single literal. Needs an explicit useState<number>.

research_findings.source: simonwillison.net scrape (delegated) + web search on top-tier 2026 portfolios
research_findings.authority_model: No credentials, degrees or job titles on the home page. Authority by volume, recency and primary-source depth. Third-party quotes embedded as proof, not flattery.
research_findings.structure: Strictly linear single column, no tables, no grid. ~12 days of entries plus a curated Highlights shelf; deep archive separate and year-indexed.
research_findings.signature_devices: Tag cloud with volume counts; quote-and-attribute entry type; curated Highlights; Colophon and Disclosures footer links.
research_findings.median_antipatterns: Scroll-jacking parallax heroes, multiple animation libraries, multi-MB payloads, 'About me' credential lists, star counts as a proxy for worth.
research_findings.fit_note: Ravani has 2 followers and 7 stars across 6 repos (verified). Social proof is unavailable and correctly omitted, so authority is substituted with demonstrated systems: the site now runs backstop's decision logic live in the page.
